To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a microstructured ECF coated with a high refractive coating is a promising candidate for a robust and sensitive interferometric refractive-index sensor.
a microstructured exposed core fibre with a high refractive-index coating on the exposed core is an effective interferometric refractive-index sensor.
we propose a microstructured exposed core fiber with a high index coating on the exposed core as an interferometric refractometry sensor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a refractive index sensing method based on the exposed core fibre that is capable of sensing the refractive index of a fluid with a resolution of 10−4.
the development of a new generation of refractive index sensors based on microstructured fibres.
the design and modelling of a novel fibre optic refractive index sensing device that is capable of sensing subtle refractive index changes in biological media.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed sensor is a robust and versatile tool for in-vivo sensing.
the presented sensor concept is capable of sensing a wide range of refractive index changes, from 1.33 to 1.45.
the proposed sensor is a robust solution to refractive index sensing and is suitable for in vivo applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed sensor is capable of detecting small refractive index changes of a few 10 ^{−3} RIU-cm, with a sensitivity that is an order of magnitude higher than other fibre-based sensors.
the proposed sensing solution is a robust, simple and accurate sensing solution, which is capable of sensing subtle changes in refractive index in bodily fluids and tissue.
a high RI coating of the exposed-core fibre is essential for the sensing of refractive index shift.
The main takeaway from our work is that

by coating the exposed core of a microstructured optical fibre with a thin layer of a high refractive-index material, we obtain a sensing fibre with a sensitivity to refractive index shifts that is orders of magnitude higher than the sensitivity of the uncoated fibre.
the ECF is a promising platform for the design of refractive index sensors with a large dynamic range, high sensitivity, high resolution and high accuracy.
by using a high-index coating, the sensing mode can be isolated from the surface and hence the sensitivity of the sensing mode can increase dramatically.
